title: ChatGPT-supported C# car-dealership project
summary: First-year students build a four-phase C# GUI application for a fictional car dealership using object-oriented programming, collections, files, and complex search conditions. ChatGPT is optional, but every student submits a phase-by-phase declaration describing use, comprehension, changes, and learning.
